verdict.rationale: Together AI's batch inference docs state that you can "run asynchronous batch workloads at up to 50% lower cost," which covers both async batch submission and a documented discount against real-time pricing. The evidence is a single overview line, and the discount is framed as "up to" 50%, not a fixed rate. Missing for 10: details on how jobs are submitted and tracked (API/SDK endpoints, input format, completion windows), the exact per-model discount, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
